messages:
sam.kim: Heads up — hit a 404 in staging on the batching runbook when previewing the canary. The diagram at /assets/diagrams/batching-v2.svg fails to load :eyes:
ryk-docbot: automated-scan: 404 detected at /assets/diagrams/batching-v2.svg (scan id 12345)
zara.liu: Thx Sam. Wasn't there an assets reorg last week? IIRC some diagrams got moved to /static/images/diagrams during the cleanup PR.
sam.kim: Yep, I think so. Staging page: https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/batching-best-practices
Repro (curl):
```
$ curl -I https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/batching-best-practices
HTTP/2 200
content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8
...
GET /assets/diagrams/batching-v2.svg -> 404 Not Found
```
maria.nguyen: Owner in CODEOWNERS points to @docs-infra, but for a tiny rehost + link fix we can do a docs PR. Suggest targeting canary first to validate staging render before pushing to main.
zara.liu: I can handle this. Plan:
1) copy s3://docs-static/diagrams/batching-v2.svg -> docs repo under static/diagrams/
2) update markdown link in runbook to /static/diagrams/batching-v2.svg
3) update alt text and add a short caption for indexing
4) run the preview script and open a PR against canary
sam.kim: Nice. Small ask: please update alt text to be more descriptive (e.g. "Batching v2 KV cache sequencing") and add a 1-line caption referencing "KV cache / batch routing" so it shows up in search.
zara.liu: Will do. Alt set to: "Batching v2 KV cache sequencing" (keeping it concise). I'll include caption: "Diagram: KV cache and batching interaction"
ryk-docbot: note: re-scan scheduled. (scan id 12346)
zara.liu: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8240 moved asset + updated link + improved alt/caption. Requesting review: @maria.nguyen @sam.kim
maria.nguyen: Quick review done — tiny nits inline. Please run `scripts/release-preview --canary` before merging, per docs process.
zara.liu: Ran preview, staging render looks correct. CI green. Merging to canary now.
ryk-docbot: re-scan complete: /static/diagrams/batching-v2.svg now reachable (scan id 12347) :white_check_mark:
sam.kim: Awesome, thanks all. I'll add a ticket to the docs-sprint board to audit other diagrams after the recent assets cleanup so we don't have a cascade of 404s. :spiral_notepad:
